name: Wabtec
outlook:
What Wabtec says to expect

  • Full year 2026: adjusted earnings per shareWabtec raised and tightened its 2026 adjusted EPS guidance range to $10.85 - $11.05, raising it $0.20 at the midpoint, or up 22.0% versus prior year.
  • Full year 2026: revenueFor the full year 2026, Wabtec continues to expect revenues to be between $12.30 billion to $12.60 billion, up 11.5% at the midpoint versus prior year.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 21, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
